# commander_manage_company (Resource)

Manages a managed company. Use this resource to create and manage a managed company's of your MSP account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Managed company (MSP accounts): name, node, plan, optional seats, file plan, and add-ons.

resource "commander_manage_company" "example" {
  name      = "Acme Corp"
  node      = "Root"
  plan      = "enterprise"
  seats     = 25
  file_plan = "1tb"

  add_ons = [
    "secrets_manager",
    "enterprise_breach_watch",
    "enterprise_audit_and_reporting",
    "password_rotation",
    "privileged_access_manager:1"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Managed Company Name.
- `node` (String) Managing Node name or ID of the managed company.
- `plan` (String) Manage Company Plan or Product. Must be one of: `business`, `businessPlus`, `enterprise`, `enterprisePlus`

### Optional

- `add_ons` (Set of String) Secure Add-Ons to apply to the Managed Company. Must be one of: `chat`, `compliance_report`, `connection_manager:N`, `enterprise_audit_and_reporting`, `enterprise_breach_watch`, `keeper_endpoint_privilege_manager:N`, `msp_service_and_support`, `password_rotation`, `privileged_access_manager:N`, `remote_browser_isolation`, `secrets_manager`
- `file_plan` (String) File storage plan. Must be one of: `100gb`, `1tb`, `10tb`
- `seats` (Number) Maximum Licenses Allowed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the managed company.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import is supported using the managed company name or ID.
terraform import commander_manage_company.example "Test Company"
# Or using the company ID:
terraform import commander_manage_company.example 1169425105420462

# Or use the import block in configuration:
# import {
#   to = commander_manage_company.example
#   id = "Test Company"
# }
# import {
#   to = commander_manage_company.example
#   id = "1169425105420462"
# }
```
